@Vibesssssss  Thank you, I'm glad you liked the model. This is a problem that happens with some AI-generated models. The .glb file has textures with coordinates, and when exported to .fbx, .obj, etc., it ignores these coordinates. The simplest solution is to bake the texture. If you use Blender, you can bake only the base color, normal, and roughness onto a new UV, and that solves the problem.
